skill.name: reporting-sprints
skill.description: Create concise sprint reports by routing sprint reporting requests to a dedicated sprint report generator agent.
skill.summary: Generate sprint reports for agile team updates and stakeholder communication.
skill.author: Emz1998

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains one instruction to use a sprint report generator agent. Static analysis found no suspicious patterns, and review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection or data exfiltration intent. No remediation is required.

content.value_statement: Teams need clear sprint summaries for planning, reviews, and stakeholder updates. This skill helps route sprint report requests to a focused reporting workflow.
actual_capabilities: Recognizes sprint reporting as the primary task context.
Directs the assistant to use a sprint report generator agent.
Supports creation of sprint summaries from user-provided sprint details.
Helps structure updates for agile teams and stakeholders.
Keeps the workflow focused on sprint reporting rather than general planning.
limitations: Requires sprint details from the user or an available project source.
Depends on access to the referenced sprint report generator agent.
Does not define a detailed report template inside the skill file.
Does not collect metrics, tickets, or velocity data by itself.

use_cases.title: Summarize Sprint Outcomes
use_cases.description: Create a concise report that covers completed work, carried-over items, blockers, and team notes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Stakeholder Updates
use_cases.description: Turn sprint notes into a readable summary for product, leadership, or client review.

use_cases.title: Review Delivery Trends
use_cases.description: Organize sprint results so managers can compare goals, delivery, risks, and follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Sprint Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sprint report for the last sprint. Include goals, completed work, blockers, and next steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have simple sprint notes and need a quick summary.

prompt_templates.title: Stakeholder Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a stakeholder-ready sprint report from these notes. Keep it concise and focus on outcomes, risks, and decisions needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the report will be shared outside the delivery team.

prompt_templates.title: Team Retrospective Input
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sprint report that highlights commitments, delivered work, missed items, blockers, and topics for retrospective discussion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a retrospective or sprint review meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Detailed Delivery Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed sprint report from these tickets, metrics, and notes. Include delivery themes, scope changes, carryover reasons, risks, and recommended follow-up actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have ticket data and need a structured delivery review.

output_examples.input: Sprint notes with completed stories, two carried-over bugs, and one blocker.
output_examples.output: A sprint summary with completed outcomes, unresolved bugs, blocker impact, and next sprint follow-up items.

output_examples.input: Raw team updates from standups and sprint review notes.
output_examples.output: A stakeholder update that explains progress, risks, decisions needed, and key delivery highlights.

output_examples.input: Ticket list, sprint goal, velocity notes, and retrospective themes.
output_examples.output: A delivery report that compares goals with results and calls out trends for the next planning session.

best_practices: Provide sprint goals, completed work, carryover items, blockers, and relevant metrics.
State the audience so the report can match the right level of detail.
Review the generated report against source tickets before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague notes when accurate sprint data is available.
Do not publish generated reports without checking project facts.
Do not use this skill for roadmap planning without sprint evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps create sprint reports by routing the task to a sprint report generator workflow.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide sprint goals, completed work, incomplete work, blockers, metrics, and audience details.

faq.question: Can it access Jira or project tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill file does not include integrations or data collection logic.

faq.question: Can it create reports for executives?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the audience and request a concise stakeholder or executive format.

faq.question: Does it define a custom report template?
faq.answer: No. It gives a simple instruction to use a sprint report generator agent.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
